messages:
Lina: Cascade Systems renewal note 1 procurement wants to split invoices (UK ops + US parent), asking for a 9-month term instead of annual, and theyre insisting on net30. They also asked if a delegated signer from their procurement team can sign on behalf of the CFO. Can Legal/Finance confirm what we need to accept that and how VAT will be applied? cc @Tomas @Priya @Jules

Tomas (Legal): We can accept delegated signers but require either: (1) a delegation letter on company letterhead naming the signer and signed by a C-level officer, or (2) an incorporation/board resolution referencing delegation. We prefer the letter for speed. Also need to confirm the signer's email matches corporate domain or provide proof.

DocuSignBot: Available workflows: `docu-sign-standard`, `delegated-signer`, `manual-upload`. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/esign-workflows. Note: `delegated-signer` requires the delegation letter PDF attached at envelope creation.

Priya (Finance): If the PO is issued to the UK entity we need their VAT number and we'll invoice in GBP. If a US entity PO is used we invoice USD and apply standard US terms. Net30 is OK but note our default is net45 so please confirm approval for net30 concession in SFDC. Also confirm billing email for each entity.

Mark (AE): I approved 9-month term as a retention concession. Pricing unchanged. I'll ask Cascade to send the PO and the delegation letter today. They said procurement would prefer card fallback if paperwork lags.

Olivia (Cascade Systems): Hi all 0 procurement can sign delegated letter, but legal review at our side asks whether onboarding can start before contract is signed. Also procurement needs a billing contact to put on the PO. We can do card fallback if needed.

Jules (Onboarding): We can begin pre-prod onboarding (training, test workspace) prior to executed agreement. Production provisioning and SSO require a signed commitment or active payment method. I can tentatively reserve a go-live window in June but need final by 2024-06-05 or I'll reassign the slot.

Tomas (Legal): I'll share a short delegation-letter template in this thread. Example:

```
To Whom It May Concern,
This letter confirms that [Name] ([Title]) is authorized to execute agreements on behalf of [Company], specifically for contracting with Redwood Inference. This authority is granted by [Officer Name], [Officer Title].
Signed: ____________________   Date: ______________
```

Please ensure letter is on company letterhead and supplied as PDF.

Priya (Finance): Action for Cascade: include billing entity, billing email, VAT number (if UK), and PO number. If they prefer card fallback, supply cardholder name and billing address. I'll provision the UK invoice code once I have VAT details.

Mark (AE): I'll chase procurement now and ask for PO + delegation letter by EOD.

Olivia (Cascade Systems): Thanks 0 I'll ask procurement to send the PO to the appropriate billing address. If we end up on card fallback we'll send card details via secure link. Also will request the delegation letter.

Lina: Putting this on our renewal tracker as `needs PO + delegation` and tagging as medium risk. Target sign date: 2024-06-05. If PO/delegation not received by 2024-06-01 move to high risk.

Jules (Onboarding): Noted. Tentative slots held until 2024-06-05.

Olivia (Cascade Systems): Update: Procurement confirmed they'll try to get PO + delegation letter to you tomorrow morning. If anything stalls I'll request card fallback.
